## Architecture registry

**arc**: Deterministic Go CLI that keeps agent-built codebases inside their architecture: a per-repo registry, placement and brief lookups, a gate for pre-commit and CI, and thin harness hook adapters. It never calls an LLM.

### Non-goals

- **no-model-calls**: arc never invokes an LLM or agent CLI; judgment is left to the caller.
- **no-server**: No daemon, server or web UI; arc is one static binary.
- **no-custom-analysis**: No custom dead-code or call-graph analysis; external tools are wrapped.

### Concepts

| Concept | Owns paths | Storage | Env | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| cli (CLI) | `cmd/arc/**` |  |  | Command-line entry point; flag parsing, dispatch, text and --json output, exit codes. *Why:* One place for argument parsing and output so behaviour stays testable in internal packages. |
| registry (Registry) | `internal/registry/**` |  |  | Schema, load, validation, glob ownership and rendering of .arch/registry.yaml. *Why:* The registry is the single source of truth; every command reads it through one loader and validator. |
| gitx (Git access) | `internal/gitx/**` |  |  | Repository root, file lists and change sets, by shelling out to git. *Why:* All git access in one place, shelling out instead of a git library (SPEC principle 5). |
| gate (Gate) | `internal/gate/**` |  |  | Deterministic checks over a change set for pre-commit and CI, one file per check. *Why:* The enforcement point for pre-commit and CI; checks share one change-set model. |
| brief (Brief and place) | `internal/brief/**` |  |  | Owning-concept lookup with closest-concept suggestions, and compact agent-facing briefs. *Why:* Agents need small, targeted context at the moment they edit; place and brief share ownership lookup. |
| initcmd (Init) | `internal/initcmd/**` |  |  | arc init — registry skeleton, --scan drafts, render, pre-commit hook and harness setup. *Why:* Adoption must be one idempotent command that never destroys existing files or hooks. |
| hook (Harness hooks) | `internal/hook/**`, `adapters/**` |  |  | Harness-agnostic hook decisions plus per-harness payload adapters. *Why:* Harness integrations stay thin adapters over shared decisions (SPEC principle 2). |
| beads (Beads integration) | `internal/beads/**` |  |  | bd CLI wrapper and bead triage against the registry; optional, skipped when bd or a workspace is missing. *Why:* Beads is reached only through the bd CLI (SPEC principle 4); one wrapper keeps that rule and the triage logic in one place. |
